description.ar: إطار يوضع فوق الصورة دون اقتطاع أي جزء منها.
description.fr: Un cadre posé sur la photo, sans rien rogner.

$comment: A frame is NOT a card. It carries no data fields: every string on it comes from brand/entities.yml, because an overlay that could be retyped per match is an overlay that will eventually go out with the competition misspelled. `formats` names shapes in the SHAPES table in tools/build-frames.mjs, not the social sizes in formats.json — a frame is sized to a photograph, not to a platform. It renders to SVG and to a transparent PNG; see logos/dist/frames/README.md.
